caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic cup with a handle, presented against a plain, light-colored background. The cup features a cylindrical body widening slightly toward the rim and sits on a rounded base. Its main section is decorated with a pink background overlaid with botanical designs: a white flower with yellow and green details, several green leaves, and additional small buds. The cup’s rim, inner surface, handle, and base are rendered in a light grayish-white, suggesting a porcelain or ceramic material. Shading is used to give the cup a three-dimensional appearance, and the drawing includes subtle shadows beneath the cup to indicate placement. The signature "Ann Bell Beadleton" appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Shaving Mug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
